newsitem.title: USA: ENCAD sees sharp rise in Q4 net, revs.
newsitem.headline: ENCAD sees sharp rise in Q4 net, revs.

text.p: ENCAD Inc said Thursday it expects 1996 fourth quarter earnings of $4.2 million, or $0.35 per share, on revenues of $33 million.
It said this would represent a 129 percent increase in earnings from the 1995 fourth quarter, and an 86 percent increase in revenues.
Analysts' consensus earnings estimate for ENCAD's fourth quarter is $0.34 a share, according to First Call.

ENCAD said for the full 1996 year, it anticipates earnings of $12.8 million, or $1.08 per share, on revenues of $107 million, representing earnings growth of 64 percent and revenue growth of 86 percent from 1995.
ENCAD attributed its growth to new imaging technology products it introduced last year. Its products are used in color inkjet printers, software, inks and media.

"We anticipate the launch of additional complementary products in 1997, and continue to remain optimistic about the full year," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer David Purcell said in a company statement.
